items.title: File Klage against building-permit refusal
items.quote: Gegen diesen Bescheid können Sie binnen eines Monats nach seiner Bekanntgabe Klage beim Bayerischen Verwaltungsgericht Musterregensburg, Haidplatz 4, 93047 Musterregensburg erheben, schriftlich oder zur Niederschrift bei der Geschäftsstelle des Gerichts.
items.computation: Letter dated 18.11.2026 (Wednesday), sent by ordinary mail. Per the letter's own clause ('Ein Bescheid, den die Behörde mit einfachem Brief verschickt, gilt am vierten Tag nach der Aufgabe zur Post als bekannt gegeben') deemed delivery = 18.11.2026 + 4 days = 22.11.2026, which is a Sunday. Under the standard fallback rule for this delivery fiction (Art. 41 Abs. 2 S.3 BayVwVfG / § 41 Abs. 2 S.3 VwVfG), if that day falls on a Saturday, Sunday or public holiday, deemed delivery shifts to the next business day, i.e. Monday 23.11.2026. The one-month Klage period then runs under §§ 57 VwGO, 222 ZPO, 187 Abs. 1, 188 Abs. 2 BGB: the day of delivery (23.11.2026) is not counted; the one-month period ends on the day of the following month bearing the same number, i.e. 23.12.2026 (a Wednesday, not a Bavarian public holiday), so no further shift is needed. Final day the Klage must reach the Verwaltungsgericht: 2026-12-23.

warnings: The letter states the postal delivery-fiction period as 'vierten Tag' (fourth day); the standard statutory wording of Art. 41 Abs. 2 BayVwVfG normally uses the third day – worth double-checking with the authority or a lawyer, since this affects the exact start of the one-month Klage deadline.
A separate fee notice (Kostenbescheid) of 120 € for the rejection was announced but not yet issued, so no due date could be set for that payment; it will need its own check once received.

No evidence of phishing or suspicious payment requests was found in this letter; the IBAN given matches the issuing Landratsamt's own account for fee payments, not a request directed at the recipient right now.
